rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in a disgraceful or dishonourable way.

example.english: We behaved ignominiously by shouting at someone at their wedding banquet; it really wasn't right.
example.traditional: 我哋好失禮咁喺人哋婚宴上面鬧人，真係唔應該。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hou2 sat1 lai5 gam3 hai2 jan4 dei6 fan1 jin3 soeng6 min6 naau6 jan4 zan1 hai6 m4 jing1 goi1

rows.note: Use this when the person is publicly humiliated or clearly loses face while doing it.

example.english: They were ignominiously scolded in front of the whole company.
example.traditional: 佢喺全公司面前冇晒面咁畀人鬧。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 cyun4 gung1 si1 min6 cin4 mou5 saai3 min6 gam3 bei2 jan4 naau6

rows.note: Use this when the ignominious manner also involves looking defeated, disordered, or making a humiliating retreat.

example.english: They fled ignominiously after being chased by a dog.
example.traditional: 佢畀隻狗追到狼狽咁逃走。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 zek3 gau2 zeoi1 dou3 long4 bui3 gam3 tou4 zau2
